title: Week 17 Mastery Quiz · Comparative Political Systems Synthesis

questions.question: Two cases have similar constitutions but different court independence scores. What design best tests institutional explanations?
options: Hold constitutional text similar and compare appointment, tenure, enforcement, and historical context
Treat the scores alone as the cause
Change both institutional definitions between cases
Select only courts with identical decisions
questions.explanation: Hold constitutional text similar and compare appointment, tenure, enforcement, and historical context

questions.question: A researcher selects cases because they both confirm the preferred theory. What is the principal threat?
options: Legal pluralism
Selection on the outcome and confirmation bias
A larger sample automatically
Excess use of primary documents
questions.explanation: Selection on the outcome and confirmation bias

questions.question: Case A reports 65% turnout among registered voters, Case B 65% among eligible adults. What is required?
options: Treat the two values as equal measures
Average the numbers
Align denominators or clearly qualify the comparison
Rank the countries by turnout alone
questions.explanation: Align denominators or clearly qualify the comparison

questions.question: A paired historical comparison finds reforms before increased participation in one country but after it in another. Which conclusion is justified?
options: Reforms caused both changes
The second country has no reform
Temporal order cannot inform analysis
A single common causal story is not established without testing sequence and rival explanations
questions.explanation: A single common causal story is not established without testing sequence and rival explanations

questions.question: An archive shows similar electoral rules but differing media access. Which dimension cannot be omitted?
options: Practical competition and rights conditions alongside formal rules
Only the number of election days
Only the text's publication language
Only the number of candidates
questions.explanation: Practical competition and rights conditions alongside formal rules

questions.question: A comparative chart uses legal independence of courts for Country A and public trust in courts for B. What correction matters?
options: Both indicators are identical
Use comparable constructs or clearly explain the difference in what is measured
Drop the source dates
Assume higher trust proves judicial independence
questions.explanation: Use comparable constructs or clearly explain the difference in what is measured

questions.question: A report attributes an institutional change solely to regime ideology. What should a senior test?
options: Only vocabulary in party speeches
Only whether the change happened
Legal constraints, coalitions, fiscal capacity, and historical alternatives
That any ideology predicts every outcome
questions.explanation: Legal constraints, coalitions, fiscal capacity, and historical alternatives

questions.question: An election study compares two countries at different historical points without explaining why. What improves validity?
options: Remove all dates
Choose the most famous country
Use a single national stereotype
State temporal scope and justify the cases and observed periods
questions.explanation: State temporal scope and justify the cases and observed periods

questions.question: A researcher finds a contrary case that weakens the preferred typology. Which scholarly response is strongest?
options: Revise the classification or identify a bounded exception with evidence
Discard the country immediately
Change the case label without explanation
Treat contradictions as irrelevant
questions.explanation: Revise the classification or identify a bounded exception with evidence

questions.question: The UN Charter Article 2 affirms sovereign equality, but two states show unequal military capacity. What distinction is required?
options: Military capacity determines Charter membership
Legal principle and empirical power distribution are different analytical dimensions
The Charter proves all states have equal armed forces
Unequal military capacity repeals Article 2
questions.explanation: Legal principle and empirical power distribution are different analytical dimensions

shortResponse: Which concepts best explain similarities and differences across political systems without erasing history and context?
rubric: 10 points: precise claim (2), accurate concepts (2), two specific pieces of evidence (2), reasoning (2), counterargument or limitation (1), revision condition (1).
